97b2(1): bstend bgyis shing //bshes gnyen 'di 'dra rnyed gyurd na//'du 'dzi ci 'dra bgyid gyurd pa//de kun bla na myed pas mkhyend//lha'i bu stobs kyi phyind kyis brlabs pas gsold pa//stobs kyi byind kyi rlabs

98a6(1): 'phruld//lha'i bu chos la 'jigs myed kyis gsold pa//kun rdzob dang ni don dam dang//de dag rab tu bstand mchis kyang//kun rdzob dang ni don ngam dang//brda' yang dmyigs su ma mchis so//lha'i bu
98a7(1): ye shes lhung lend kyis gsold pa//brjod pa thams cad rna gzhan//chos kyi mtshan nyid rnam pa gzhan//mtshan nyid ma mchis brjod ma mchis//khyod kyis chos kyi mtshan nyid gzigs//lha'i bu lam la gtson pas gsol
98a8(1): pa//nges par gyurd pa'i sems can rnams //gzhan gyi rgyud mchi'i gnas ma mchis//log par des rnams kun tu 'gror//drang srong chen po khyod kyis gzigs//lha'i bu mos pa'i stobs kyis gsold pa//khams gang
98a9(1): la ni bstend bgyis te//gang rnams ci 'drar mos gyurd cing//'dod chags khams la sdug bsngal ba//de dag thub chen khyod kyis gzigs//lha 'i bu myi sdug pa las nges par 'byung gis gsold pa//ma mchis
98a10(1): yongs su brtags pas na//'dod chags khams ni rab tu phyung//de la mos pa nges 'byung ba//de dag khyod kyis ci bzhin gzigs//lha'i bu byams pa nges pas nges par 'byung gis gsald pa
98b1(1): ma mchis yongs su brtags pas na//zhe sdang khams ni rab tu byung//de la mos la nges 'byung pa//de dag khyod kyis ji bzhin gzigs//lha'i bu rkyen 'dis nges par byung gis gsold pa//ma mchis 
98b2(1): yongs su brtags pas na//gti mug khams ni rab tu byung //de la mos pa nges 'byung ba//de dag khyod kyis ci bzhin gzigs//lha'i bu gtong bas nges par 'byung gis gsold pa//'tsho myed 'jigs
98b3(1): pa rnyed pa dag//ser sna mngon bar 'phel 'gyurd te//de la mos pa nges 'byang ba//de dag thub cen khyod kyis gzigs//lha'i bu dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis nges par 'byung gis gsald pa//sdig pa'i
98b4(1): grogs dang 'grogs pas na//mthun pa'i khams ni rab tu 'byung //de la mos pa thos 'gyur ba//de dag 'drend pas rnam par mkhyend//lha'i bu rnam (bar)shes pa snying por 'dzind pas gsold pa//'khor ba (na)
98b5(1): na ni 'khor rnams kyis//ji 'dra'i khams la bstend pa dang//mos de mthard phyind pa dag//khyod kyis ma lus rab tu mkhyend//lha'i bu nan tan snying por byed pas gsold pa//'khod ba nan
98b6(1): 'khor rnams kyis//gang gis rgyu 'byung nan tan dang//mos pa de las gyurd pa yang//smad pa myed pa khyod kyis gzigs gas//lha'i bu dbang po la mos gsold pa//sems can gang gis
98b7(1): khams gang la//brtend na ji ltar 'gyur ba'i//rgyu de khyod kyis rab tu mkhyend//des na khyod ni dga' bar mdzad//lha'i dbang po la spyod pas gsold pa//sbyor ba gang gis skye ba dang//gang gis rgya chen
98b8(1): skye ba dang//dmyigs pa dang ni zhing rnams dang//dbang po khyod kyis rab tu mkhyen da//lha'i bu dbang pos nges par 'byung gis gsold pa//'dod pa'i sdug bsngal gnod gyurd dang//sred par mngon par 'jug
98b9(1): pa dang//sred pa zhi bar bgyid pa'i don//de dag smra ba'i mchog gis mkhyend//lha'i bu dbang po'i spyod yul gyis gsold pa//dbang po nyams chung rnams dag ni//gzugs kyi 'dod rnams dben bar 
98b10(1): 'tshald//sred pa rnam bar gzhig pa yang//rkang gnyis dam pas bstand mdzad pa//lha'i bu dbang (po)rnam par rgyal bas gsol pa//dpa' bo rtul bo dur khrod brtend//rang gi 'dod chags zhi bar bgyid//rkang
99a1(1): /gnyis gtso bo'i zhal mthong nas//sred dang bcas pas khyod la lta//lha'i bu dbang po rtogs kyis gsold pa//'dod chags can dang 'dod chags dang //zhi dang shes dang myi shes dang //sred pa zhi dang dbang

99a5(1): rnam par rtog pa dang//log par nye bar stond pa yang //nyon mongs sa dom phyid kun sbyor te//bzlog pas thard par 'gyur pa gzigs//lha'i bu ye shes yang dag shadad kyis gsold pa//'dod chags zhe sdang

99a7(1): mug dang//mun pa snang ba dngos po rnams//rang bzhin nyid kyis ma mchis te//de ni rkang gnyis gtso bos gzigs//lha'i bu snang pa 'dzind kyis gsold pa//sems can gang dag shes pa gang//ci tsam yongs su bsgrub
99a8(1): bgyis dang//snod du gang rung ji snyed pa//de dag myi mchog khyod kyis mkhyend//lha 'i bu dbang po dang zhe 'gras pas gsold pa//nyon mongs spang phyir shes gang gis//shes pa de la rtogs bgyid pa//de yang stond pa khyod kyis 
99a9(1): mkhyend//de bas spyod la mngon par dga'//lha'i bu dbang po la dga' bas gsold pa//yul dang dus dang gnas dag dang//spyod pa rnam par bsgom ba dang//nyon mongs snyon rmongs rnam dag pa//thub pa khyod kyis stong par gzigs
99a10(1): lha'i bu ye shes rgyal mtshan gyis gsold pa//dbang po rno rtul 'bring dag dang//gang zag gi bsam ba dang//bcings dang thard dang zad dang shes//gsol ba myed par khyod kyis mkhyend//lha'i bu dbang po'i rgyal mtshan gyis
99b1(1): gsold pa//dbang po rab 'bring rtul ba dang//nyon mongs ye shes tshor ba dang//'dul dang 'dul bar bsgyid pa dag//khyod kyis mtshan nyid myed par gsungs//lha'i dbang po rnam par brtags kyis gsold pa//
99b2(1): sems can rnams kyi bsam gtan dang//rnam thard kun nas nyon mongs dang//snyoms 'jug ting 'dzind ldang ba dang//rnam byang thub pa khyod kyis mkhyend pa//lha'i bu stobs kyi shugs kyis gsold pa//zhi ba'i
99b3(1): ting nge 'dzind brtend te//chos kun ngo bo nyid kyis ni//rang bzhin myed par khyod kyis mkhyend//des na thams cad mkhyend ces bgyi//lha'i bu stobs kyi go chas gsold pa//chos rnams gang dang rang bzhin gang//

99b6(1): bstand par khyod kyis rab du mkhyend//des na khyod pa la do zla myed//lha'i bu sobs kyi 'od kyis gsold pa//bsam gtan rnaMs dang rnam thard dang//snyoms par 'jug pa ting 'dzind dang//kun

100b10(1): mchis shing sgrib pa gang rnyed nas//'bras bu thob par myi 'gyur ba//de kun spyan ldan khyod kyis mkhyend//lha'i bu dmyigs pa la mkhas pas gsold pa //'gro ba dag tu skye rnams kyi//gang gis las rnams smyind 'gyur
